question.text: An AIF must carry out a yearly audit of the PPM. By when must the audit findings and proposed corrective measures be communicated to stakeholders?

answer.text: Within 6 months from the end of the financial year
Within 3 months from the end of the financial year
Within 30 days from the end of the financial year
Within 1 year from the end of the financial year

explanation.text: The Logic: Annual PPM audit findings along with corrective measures must be communicated to stakeholders within 6 months from the end of each financial year. The Trap: 30 days and 3 months are too short for a full audit cycle; 1 year is inconsistent with 'yearly' intent. Cross-Exam Context: Identical requirement applies to Cat I/II (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Diary the PPM-audit date 90 days before year-end so auditors have lead time and the 6-month deadline is met comfortably.
